description: B6 forward benchmark with positivity at stake, d = 3 and d = 4: D^alpha rho = L[rho] on tau in [0,1] with a constant GKSL generator and a pure initial state, so that the trajectory starts on the boundary of the state space and stays on it (two_qubit: one eigenvalue is exactly zero for all tau) or close to it (qutrit: smallest eigenvalue below 0.02)

qutrit.model: driven dissipative ladder qutrit, levels |0> (ground), |1>, |2>; H = (O1/2)(|0><1| + h.c.) + (O2/2)(|1><2| + h.c.) + D2 |2><2|; jumps sqrt(g10)|0><1|, sqrt(g21)|1><2|, sqrt(gphi)(|1><1| + 2|2><2|)

two_qubit.model: two exchange-coupled qubits, basis |ee>, |eg>, |ge>, |gg>; H = J (s+ s- + s- s+) + (delta/2)(sz x 1 - 1 x sz); jumps sqrt(g1) s- x 1, sqrt(g2) 1 x s-, sqrt(gphi/2) sz x 1; the excitation number is not increased, so |ee> is never populated from |eg>

variants.note: hard initial condition throughout; factor with the exp gate is the method of the first campaign
